name: Bluephobia
source:
Your world seems very small now that you are in space, by accident that is.
the blue alien says that he had no other choose except for take you with or you end up dying in the middle of nowhere, he kind of feels responsible for the crash that you got into.

Also it seems he is hiding something from you, and it seems very heavy on his shoulders.

[From [url=https://kirmalight.itch.io/bluephobia]Itch.io[/url]]
